# DirectX SDK June 2010 headers

The XAudio 2.7 compatibility layer requires the original XAudio 2.7 ABI declarations.
The five headers in `Include/` were taken unchanged from Microsoft's DirectX SDK
(June 2010):

https://download.microsoft.com/download/A/E/7/AE743F1F-632B-4809-87A9-AA1BB3458E31/DXSDK_Jun10.exe

Before publishing this repository, confirm that redistribution of these SDK headers
is compatible with the intended public-source distribution. They are build inputs
only and are not copied into the SCBL client package.
